# mtncloud_user_role (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud user role data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_user_role" "example_user_role" {
  name = "Terraform Example User"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud user role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
